candidate.text_basis:
请为乙醇（中性、单重态）生成一份结构，保持完全相同的原子顺序和坐标，自行选择同一方法与基组，分别计算气相与ORCA C-PCM水环境下的单点电子能量。除溶剂模型和它必需的参数外，两次科学设置保持一致；不要分别优化两套几何。交付两份原始输入输出、共用XYZ及hash、绝对能量（Eh），并按ΔE=E(C-PCM水)-E(气相)给出kJ/mol差值及符号解释。说明溶剂设置、来源和计算限制；这个量是指定模型下的电子能量差，不得称为完整水合自由能或补造热修正、标准态修正。

若结构生成、搜索或其他算法使用随机数，请统一采用种子 1701 并在报告中记录；若某一库或模型不支持固定种子，明确记为不可固定，不伪造确定性。

decisions.reason: Identity resolution is complete; the only ready execution Step is structure.prepare for system_ethanol. Running it prepares the shared initial XYZ required before method/basis selection and ORCA single-point planning.

basis.reason: A consistent triple-zeta polarized orbital basis for both single-point calculations, keeping the gas-phase and C-PCM water environments comparable while remaining within the available calculation budget.

method.reason: A standard closed-shell hybrid DFT method suitable for a neutral singlet organic molecule; the same method will be used for both the gas-phase and C-PCM water single-point calculations. This is a consistency choice, not independent literature validation.
